description: Get full details for a single eBay item via SerpAPI (engine `ebay_product`). Pass `product_id` — the eBay item id taken from an `ebay_search` result's `product_id` field (also the number in an /itm/<id> URL). Returns product_results (title, pricing/buying options, condition, quantity, shipping, specifications, variations, media, returns), seller_results and related_products. Use `ebay_domain` to match the marketplace the item was found on.

ebay_domain.description: eBay marketplace domain the item is on, e.g. 'ebay.com' (default), 'ebay.de', 'ebay.co.uk'.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. 'en-US' (default). Only used for the US eBay domain when locale is set.

locale.description: Origin location the request should appear to come from.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

product_id.description: eBay item id — the `product_id` from an ebay_search result (or the number in an /itm/<id> URL).

shipping_country.description: Destination country code used to calculate shipping data.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: ebay_product
title: Get eBay product details (SerpAPI)
